name: Radix Icons
summary: Set of 15×15 icons in 12 categories by the WorkOS team, downloadable as SVG or installable as React components.
description: A crisp 15×15 icon set spanning categories such as Typography, Music, Arrows, Objects, Design, Components, Borders and corners and Alignment. Every icon can be opened in Figma, downloaded as SVG or installed as an individual React component from npm; the set is MIT licensed.
contains: download SVG, open in Figma, install with npm
